metadata.utc_conversion_method: NAIF LSK DELTET periodic model, solved by fixed-point iteration. TDB-TT accuracy is about 30 microseconds, excluding floating-point Julian-date rounding. Horizons printed epochs have 1e-9 day precision.
metadata.leap_second_warning: Pinned naif0012.tls has TAI-UTC=37 s from 2017-01-01. UTC dates beyond its last entry assume no unannounced leap seconds. Future leap seconds would change the UTC interpretation, not stored TDB states.
metadata.sampling: Equal TDB intervals between the two converted UTC boundaries.
